articles.title: GitHub - rohitg00/agentmemory: Persistent memory for AI coding agents · GitHub
articles.summary: AI coding agents typically suffer from a 'blind spot' due to their lack of persistent memory across sessions, hindering long-term learning. A new system, powered by the 'iii-engine', introduces persistent memory to overcome this limitation. This innovation allows agents to retain information, learn more effectively over time, and significantly enhances their long-term capabilities and efficiency for complex coding tasks.

articles.title: India-US defence ties pick up as Air Chief Marshal AP Singh visits US to strengthen partnership
articles.summary: Indian Air Force Air Chief Marshal Amar Preet Singh has arrived in the United States to significantly strengthen the India-US defence partnership. This high-level visit aims to deepen strategic cooperation, enhance military interoperability, and address shared security challenges. His presence underscores the growing importance of this bilateral relationship for regional stability and global security interests, reflecting crucial diplomatic and military engagement.

articles.title: Why Malcolm in the Middle’s Dewey Actor Said No to ‘Buckets of Money’
articles.summary: Fans are eagerly awaiting the April 10, 2026 revival of the iconic sitcom "Malcolm in the Middle." However, Erik Per Sullivan, who played a familiar character in the original series, will be notably absent from the upcoming reboot. This news marks a significant change for the much-anticipated return, disappointing many who looked forward to seeing the full original cast.

articles.title: Bryan Cranston Says “Comedy Is Essential Right Now” Amid “Bombardment” Of Constant News Cycle
articles.summary: Actor Bryan Cranston is reportedly assisting in the revival of the popular television series 'Malcolm in the Middle' for streaming platforms Hulu/Disney+. The project aims to reunite the original dysfunctional family from the show. This development signifies potential new content for fans, with further details regarding its production and storyline expected to emerge as the revival progresses.

articles.title: Israel Iran War Day 38 Updates: US, Iran explore 45-day ceasefire as UAE intercepts attacks, oil tops $110 per barrel
articles.summary: The Iran-Israel war entered Day 38, accompanied by a major diplomatic push. The US, Iran, and regional mediators are discussing a proposed 45-day ceasefire. This aims to halt hostilities and potentially pave the way for de-escalation, involving key international actors in an effort to resolve the protracted conflict.
